verdict.vacuity_reading: the frozen non-vacuity rule requires a blanked expansion to score STRICTLY BELOW the candidate. The candidate recovered nothing, so blanked ties it and the rule reports vacuous=True; under the charter's literal tie clause this would void a PROMOTION run. Adjudication, recorded rather than smoothed over: (a) the tie is a TRUE NULL, not a broken harness - the A1 channel changed the pooled row count on 0 of 15 retrieval cells (served questions and legs), so the pooling and scoring machinery registers improvements when the search returns them; (b) the A3 shuffled control passed on every served question (no coverage raised on the target); (c) the frozen RULES.json thresholds route ANY failure of an outcome-A criterion, including this vacuity tie, to OUTCOME_B_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE, whose own charter definition describes exactly the true-null case ('no in-budget deterministic expansion recovers the missing concepts or authority ids'); (d) regression_suite.py test_metric_sensitivity_non_vacuity proves the coverage and recall axes register an injected improvement directly. The negative verdict does not depend on the vacuity rule: improved_fr_it_cells is 0 and reduced questions is 0 regardless.
